overview.en: Pediatric musculoskeletal disorders: developmental dysplasia of the hip, clubfoot, scoliosis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, Marfan syndrome, Legg-Calve-Perthes disease, fractures with traction and casts, and osteomyelitis.
overview.zh: 兒童肌肉骨骼疾病：發展性髖關節發育不良、內翻足、脊柱側彎、幼年特發性關節炎、馬凡氏症候群、Legg-Calve-Perthes病、骨折與牽引/石膏、骨髓炎。

heading.zh: 發展性髖關節發育不良（DDH）

points.en: Femoral head seated improperly in the acetabulum; degrees: acetabular dysplasia (mildest), subluxation, dislocation.
points.zh: 股骨頭未正確位於髖臼；程度：髖臼發育不良（最輕）、半脫位、脫位。

points.en: Neonate: ligament laxity; positive Ortolani (click as head relocates) and Barlow (head dislocates) tests.
points.zh: 新生兒：韌帶鬆弛；Ortolani陽性（股骨頭復位時有彈響）、Barlow陽性（股骨頭脫出）。

points.en: Infant: shortened leg (Galeazzi/Allis), limited hip abduction, asymmetric gluteal folds.
points.zh: 嬰兒：患側肢體縮短（Galeazzi/Allis徵象）、髖外展受限、臀紋不對稱。

points.en: Older child: shorter leg, positive Trendelenburg (pelvis drops on the normal side), prominent greater trochanter, waddling gait/lordosis if bilateral.
points.zh: 較大兒童：患肢較短、Trendelenburg陽性（健側骨盆下垂）、大轉子突出、雙側者鴨步/腰椎前凸。

points.en: 0-6 months: Pavlik harness (flexion, abduction), worn 23 h/day, removed only for bathing, 6-12 weeks.
points.zh: 0-6個月：Pavlik吊帶（屈曲、外展），每天配戴23小時，僅洗澡時取下，6-12週。

points.en: 6-18 months: traction then closed/open reduction and hip spica cast 6-12 weeks, then brace ~6 weeks; older child needs surgery.
points.zh: 6-18個月：牽引後閉鎖/開放復位並打髖人字石膏6-12週，再用支架約6週；較大兒童需手術。

points.en: Forefoot adduction, midfoot supination, hindfoot varus, ankle equinus; may be unilateral or bilateral.
points.zh: 前足內收、中足旋後、後足內翻、踝馬蹄足；可單側或雙側。

points.en: Terms: varus = inward, valgus = outward, equinus = plantar flexion (toes lower), calcaneus = dorsiflexion.
points.zh: 名詞：varus＝內翻、valgus＝外翻、equinus＝蹠屈（腳趾低於腳跟）、calcaneus＝背屈。

points.en: Goal: painless, stable plantigrade foot; follow-up to skeletal maturity.
points.zh: 目標：無痛、穩定的蹠行足；追蹤至骨骼成熟。

points.en: Start treatment soon after birth: weekly manipulation and casting 8-12 weeks, then splint; surgery if alignment not achieved by 6-12 weeks of age.
points.zh: 出生後盡早治療：每週手法矯正與石膏8-12週，之後夾板；6-12週齡未矯正則手術。

points.en: Monitor pain and toe neurovascular status; report impairment immediately.
points.zh: 監測疼痛與腳趾神經血管狀態；有異常立即通報。

points.en: Three-dimensional spine deformity with lateral curve and rotation; found in preadolescent growth spurt, so screen then.
points.zh: 三度空間脊柱變形，含側彎與旋轉；於青春期前生長快速期發現，故需在此時篩檢。

points.en: Adam's forward-bend test shows rib/flank asymmetry; also uneven shoulders, hips, rib hump; X-ray confirms.
points.zh: Adam前彎測試可見肋骨/腰側不對稱；另有肩、髖不等高、肋骨隆起；X光確診。

points.en: Brace 16-23 h/day slows progression (not curative); check skin, keep clean/dry, no lotion/powder, soft clothing underneath, exercises, address body image.
points.zh: 背架每日16-23小時，減緩進展（非治癒）；檢查皮膚、保持清潔乾燥、不擦乳液/粉、內穿柔軟衣物、運動、處理身體心像。

points.en: Spinal fusion postop: logroll, keep alignment, neurovascular checks, pulmonary hygiene, pain control, watch for incontinence/infection.
points.zh: 脊椎融合術後：軸線翻身、維持排列、神經血管評估、肺部衛生、止痛、注意失禁/感染。

points.en: Superior mesenteric artery syndrome: vomiting and abdominal distention after fusion; notify the provider.
points.zh: 腸繫膜上動脈症候群：融合術後嘔吐與腹脹；通知醫師。

points.en: Autoimmune joint inflammation; no cure; care preserves function and limits deformity via an interprofessional team.
points.zh: 自體免疫性關節發炎；無法治癒；由跨專業團隊保存功能並減少變形。

points.en: Findings: stiff, swollen, warm, tender joints, morning stiffness and after inactivity; uveitis may cause blindness; no definitive test (ESR, WBC may be raised).
points.zh: 表現：關節僵硬、腫脹、發熱、壓痛；晨僵與休息後僵硬；葡萄膜炎可致失明；無決定性檢驗（ESR、WBC可能升高）。

points.en: Meds: intra-articular steroids for few joints; short low-dose oral steroids; DMARDs and biologics (anti-TNF) second line.
points.zh: 藥物：少數關節用關節內類固醇；短期低劑量口服類固醇；DMARDs與生物製劑（抗TNF）為第二線。

points.en: Care: ROM, heat/cold, splinting in neutral position, isometric exercises during flares, PT/OT, regular eye exams, support normal ADLs.
points.zh: 照護：關節活動、冷熱敷、中立位夾板、發作期做等長運動、PT/OT、定期眼科檢查、鼓勵一般日常活動。

points.en: Connective tissue disorder (fibrillin-1 gene) affecting skeletal, cardiovascular and ocular systems; no cure.
points.zh: 結締組織疾病（fibrillin-1基因），影響骨骼、心血管與眼睛；無法治癒。

points.en: Tall thin build, long limbs and slender fingers, spinal curvature, vision and heart problems.
points.zh: 高瘦體型、長肢細指、脊柱彎曲、視力與心臟問題。

points.en: Care: regular eye exams, monitor spine, heart-rate-slowing drugs to protect aorta, avoid competitive and contact sports, antibiotic prophylaxis before dental work, possible aortic root surgery.
points.zh: 照護：定期眼科檢查、監測脊柱、減慢心率藥物保護主動脈、避免競技與接觸性運動、牙科處置前預防性抗生素、可能需主動脈根部手術。

points.en: Temporary loss of blood supply to the femoral head causes bone death and growth arrest.
points.zh: 股骨頭血供暫時中斷，造成骨壞死與生長停止。

points.en: Signs: limp, hip/groin/thigh/knee pain or stiffness, limited ROM.
points.zh: 徵象：跛行、髖/鼠蹊/大腿/膝痛或僵硬、關節活動受限。

points.en: Care: PT stretching, crutches to avoid weight bearing, bed rest/traction if severe, casting, night brace, hip surgery.
points.zh: 照護：物理治療伸展、拐杖避免患髖承重、重症臥床/牽引、石膏、夜間支架、髖部手術。

points.en: Fractures in infancy are rare: investigate for child abuse and bone disease.
points.zh: 嬰兒期骨折少見：須調查是否為兒虐或骨骼疾病。

points.en: Signs: pain, deformity, edema, bruising, spasm, loss of function, crepitus.
points.zh: 徵象：疼痛、變形、水腫、瘀青、肌肉痙攣、功能喪失、骨摩擦音。

points.en: First aid: immobilize, check neurovascular status, cover open wound with sterile dressing, elevate, apply cold, transport.
points.zh: 急救：固定、檢查神經血管、開放傷口以無菌敷料覆蓋、抬高、冰敷、送醫。

points.en: Reduction is closed (manual) or open (internal fixation); retention with traction or cast.
points.zh: 復位分閉鎖（手法）與開放（內固定）；以牽引或石膏維持。

points.en: Traction: Russell, balanced suspension, 90-90; keep prescribed weights hanging freely, ropes in pulleys and unfrayed, neurovascular checks, pin care, prevent immobility complications, provide play.
points.zh: 牽引：Russell、平衡懸吊、90-90牽引；依醫囑重量並使重物自由懸空、繩索在滑輪上且無磨損、神經血管評估、針道護理、預防不動併發症、提供遊戲。

points.en: Cast care: check for pressure/hot spots, petal rough edges, keep clean and dry, no objects inside, isometric exercise; signs of compartment syndrome (pain beyond expected, pallor, numbness, coolness, diminished pulse) = notify PHCP, bivalve cast, possible fasciotomy.
points.zh: 石膏照護：檢查壓迫/熱點、邊緣修平、保持乾燥清潔、不塞異物、等長運動；骨筋膜室症候群徵象（疼痛過度、蒼白、麻木、冰冷、脈搏減弱）＝通知醫師、剖開石膏、可能需筋膜切開術。

points.en: Bone infection, usually Staphylococcus aureus.
points.zh: 骨骼感染，常見金黃色葡萄球菌。

points.en: Signs: pain, fever, irritability, lethargy, warm tender limb, decreased ROM.
points.zh: 徵象：疼痛、發燒、易怒、嗜睡、患肢溫熱壓痛、活動受限。

points.en: Care: comfort positioning, splint, non-weight bearing; start antibiotics after cultures; long-term IV (PICC); surgery if no response; pain control, PT/OT.
points.zh: 照護：舒適擺位、夾板、免承重；採檢後開始抗生素；長期靜脈（PICC）；無效則手術；止痛、PT/OT。

critical_points.en: Pavlik harness: worn 23 hours/day, removed only for bathing; maintains flexion and abduction.
critical_points.zh: Pavlik吊帶：每天23小時，僅洗澡取下；維持屈曲與外展。

critical_points.en: Ortolani = relocation click; Barlow = dislocation; asymmetrical gluteal folds and limited abduction in infants.
critical_points.zh: Ortolani＝復位彈響；Barlow＝脫位；嬰兒臀紋不對稱與外展受限。

critical_points.en: Positive Trendelenburg sign in older child with DDH.
Clubfoot treatment begins immediately after birth with weekly casting for 8-12 weeks.
critical_points.zh: 內翻足出生後立即開始，每週石膏約8-12週。

critical_points.en: Neurovascular compromise in a casted extremity: notify PHCP immediately; prepare for bivalving.
critical_points.zh: 石膏肢體神經血管受損：立即通報；準備剖開石膏。

critical_points.en: Scoliosis screening: Adam's forward-bend test during preadolescent growth spurt.
critical_points.zh: 脊柱側彎篩檢：青春期前生長期做Adam前彎測試。

critical_points.en: Brace 16-23 h/day; no lotions or powders under brace; soft cloth underneath.
critical_points.zh: 背架每天16-23小時；架下不擦乳液/粉；內穿柔軟布料。

critical_points.en: After spinal fusion: logroll; vomiting with abdominal distention = superior mesenteric artery syndrome; call provider.
critical_points.zh: 脊椎融合後：軸線翻身；嘔吐加腹脹＝腸繫膜上動脈症候群；通知醫師。

critical_points.en: JIA: morning stiffness, uveitis risk (eye exams); no definitive test.
critical_points.zh: JIA：晨僵、葡萄膜炎風險（需眼科檢查）；無決定性檢驗。

critical_points.en: JIA flares: isometric exercises, neutral splinting, heat/cold.
critical_points.zh: JIA發作期：等長運動、中立位夾板、冷熱敷。

critical_points.en: Marfan: avoid contact/competitive sports; antibiotics before dental work; aortic and eye monitoring.
critical_points.zh: 馬凡氏症：避免接觸/競技運動；牙科前預防性抗生素；監測主動脈與眼睛。

critical_points.en: Legg-Calve-Perthes: avascular necrosis of femoral head; crutches, avoid weight bearing.
critical_points.zh: Legg-Calve-Perthes：股骨頭缺血性壞死；用拐杖、避免承重。

critical_points.en: Traction: weights hang freely, ropes in pulleys; absent distal pulse = emergency, notify provider (do not release traction without order).
critical_points.zh: 牽引：重物自由懸空、繩在滑輪上；遠端脈搏消失＝緊急，通知醫師（無醫囑不可放鬆牽引）。

critical_points.en: No lotion/powder, objects, or shoe polish on or in a cast; no heating pad for cold fingers.
critical_points.zh: 石膏上或內不使用乳液/粉、異物、鞋油；手指冰冷不可用熱敷墊。

critical_points.en: Osteomyelitis: get cultures before antibiotics; S. aureus most common.
critical_points.zh: 骨髓炎：先採檢再給抗生素；以金黃色葡萄球菌最常見。

mnemonics.en: Compartment syndrome '6 Ps': Pain, Pallor, Pulselessness, Paresthesia, Paralysis, Pressure (poikilothermia/coolness).
mnemonics.zh: 骨筋膜室症候群「6P」：疼痛、蒼白、無脈、感覺異常、麻痺、壓力（及冰冷）。

mnemonics.en: Ortolani = 'Out to In' (click as head moves into socket); Barlow = 'Out the back' (head pops out).
mnemonics.zh: Ortolani＝「入」（股骨頭回到髖臼有彈響）；Barlow＝「出」（股骨頭向後脫出）。

stem.en: A child in temporary skin traction for a femur fracture has an absent dorsalis pedis pulse on the affected foot. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 股骨骨折暫時使用皮膚牽引的孩童，患足足背動脈消失。護理師應？

rationale.en: Absent pulse suggests compromised circulation/compartment syndrome, an emergency. Ice worsens perfusion; traction is not released without an order.
rationale.zh: 脈搏消失提示循環受損/骨筋膜室症候群，為緊急狀況；冰敷會惡化灌流；無醫囑不可放鬆牽引。

stem.en: Which finding in a 1-month-old suggests developmental dysplasia of the hip?

options.en: Limited abduction of the affected hip
Lengthened femur on the affected side

rationale.en: DDH shows limited abduction, asymmetric folds and apparent shortening (Galeazzi).
rationale.zh: DDH表現為外展受限、臀紋不對稱與肢體縮短（Galeazzi）。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statement by a parent of an infant in a Pavlik harness shows understanding?
stem.zh: Pavlik吊帶嬰兒的家長哪項說法顯示理解？

options.en: "I will remove it every few hours to let him stretch."
"It stays on 23 hours a day and comes off only for baths."
"I will put powder under the straps."

rationale.en: The harness is worn nearly continuously for about 6-12 weeks.
rationale.zh: 吊帶需幾乎持續配戴約6-12週。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A child who had spinal fusion for scoliosis develops vomiting and abdominal distention. What is the best action?
stem.zh: 脊椎融合術後孩童出現嘔吐與腹脹。最佳行動？

rationale.en: These signs suggest superior mesenteric artery syndrome mimicking obstruction/ileus.
rationale.zh: 這些徵象提示腸繫膜上動脈症候群，類似腸阻塞/麻痺性腸阻塞。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which instructions are correct for a child with a scoliosis brace? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 脊柱側彎背架孩童哪些指導正確？（複選）

options.en: Wear soft cloth under the brace

rationale.en: Lotions and powders cake and break down skin.
rationale.zh: 乳液與粉會結塊並破壞皮膚。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: During a painful flare of juvenile idiopathic arthritis, what exercise advice is best?
stem.zh: JIA疼痛發作期，最佳運動建議？

rationale.en: Isometric exercise and neutral positioning maintain function during flares.
rationale.zh: 發作期等長運動與中立位擺位維持功能。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statement shows a parent needs further teaching about plaster cast care?
stem.zh: 哪項家長說法顯示石膏照護需再衛教？

options.en: "The cast may feel warm as it dries."
"I'll use powder around the edges for itching."
"I will keep the arm elevated for 24-48 hours."
"I'll call if his fingers become numb."

rationale.en: Powders/lotions near cast edges irritate skin and may fall inside.
rationale.zh: 石膏邊緣用粉或乳液會刺激皮膚並可能掉入內部。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A 10-year-old with osteomyelitis is to start IV antibiotics. What must be done first?
stem.zh: 10歲骨髓炎孩童將開始靜脈抗生素。首先應完成？

rationale.en: Antibiotics are started after appropriate cultures are obtained.
rationale.zh: 於取得適當培養後才開始抗生素。
